audio_spectrum.label: React to music
audio_spectrum.description: Makes Mochi smile on strong audio beats.

activity_awareness.label: React to focused app
activity_awareness.description: Reads only the Niri focused window title and app ID locally.

animation_speed.label: Energy
animation_speed.description: Controls how often Mochi blinks and changes expression.

anime_moments.label: Anime-inspired moments
anime_moments.description: Lets Mochi choose from 120 original dramatic, funny, cozy, and heroic eye animations.

gif_moments.label: Animated GIF moments
gif_moments.description: Occasionally plays an original low-resolution GIF from Mochi's bundled animation pack.

moment_frequency.label: Moment frequency
moment_frequency.description: Controls how often Mochi chooses a cinematic moment by himself.
